thread:
elaine: Quick sync request — PMs pushed a set of customer asks around routing governance + tenant isolation. Need to prioritize features and define launch gates. High level: predictable region affinity, per-tenant isolation profiles, policy orchestration.

miguel: Which customers and what level of commitment?

elaine: Nora listed three pilot customers: AcmeRetail (latency + multi-region failover), FinBank (data residency + stronger isolation), HealthCo (air-gapped-ish, audit logs). They want: 1) ability to pin region affinity with SLA tiers, 2) opt-in tenant isolation profiles (bronze/silver/gold semantics), 3) policy-as-code + UI for routing rules and precedence.

samir: Quick engineering callout — hard reservations for GPUs will fragment capacity and raise unit costs. For MVP we should do: tag-based routing + soft quotas + predictable fallback lanes. Launch criteria should include validated e2e fallbacks and a cost study.

nora: From PM side, acceptance criteria we need in PRD: - pilot with 2 customers successfully routing >95% traffic to chosen region for 24h, - isolation profile docs & audit logs, - SLA met for p95 latency on gold lane. Timebox = one quarter for MVP.

ricardo: Runtime constraints worth noting: current KV cache + batching assumes homogeneous model pool. If we add per-tenant isolation lanes, we must ensure cache warming doesn’t blow latency. Suggest phased rollout: (A) policy precedence + label-based routing, (B) per-tenant soft reservations, (C) hard reservations if customers pay for it.

elaine: Proposed roadmap (first pass): Q3: policy labels + routing precedence + fallback lanes; Q4: reservation API (soft quotas) + billing meter for lanes; Q1 next year: UI for policy orchestration, canary rollouts, and hard reservation support. Add canary gating and rollback plan to each stage.

miguel: Draft gating checklist (we should include in PRD):
```
- functional: routing rules applied and honored (unit + integ tests)
- reliability: failover < 500ms to fallback lane (simulated)
- economics: cost-per-token delta < X% for gold lane (tbd)
- security/compliance: audit logs + KMS integration validated
- customer signoff: pilot customer ok + runbook
```

samir: :thumbsup: I can own infra validation/chaos tests once PRD is shipped. Estimate ~6 weeks of sprint work to get the gating tests green.

nora: Also add a console requirement: transparent per-lane cost calc and an immediate fallback toggle for support. If possible, include a short-run cost estimator in the tenant settings.

elaine: Agreed — add cost transparency, rollback procedures, and a migration path for existing tenants in the PRD. I'll update the doc and tag owners. Asking @miguel and @ricardo to sketch the minimal rule schema and the runtime constraints by EOD tomorrow.

ricardo: Will do. Minimal schema suggestion to share: ```policy { tenant_id: string, priority: int, region_affinity: [region], lane: enum{bronze,silver,gold}, fallback: policy_id }``` — keep it tiny for now.

miguel: I'll draft the policy-as-code example and a short migration plan (auto-tagging heuristics) by EOD.

product-bot: PRD draft created: /docs/prd/routing-governance-mvp.md — reviewers: elaine, nora, ricardo, samir.

elaine: Thanks — let's reconvene after those artifacts. No blockers for kickoff once PRD + gating checklist are in place.
